title: DeepSeek V4.1-Flash Launches on WorkBuddy, Begins Limited-Time Free Trial
excerpt: The iteration speed in the field of large-scale artificial intelligence models is continuously accelerating. AI service platform WorkBuddy has recently official
content_html:
The iteration speed in the field of large-scale artificial intelligence models is continuously accelerating. AI service platform WorkBuddy has recently officially announced that its platform has fully launched the latest V4.1-Flash model from DeepSeek, and has also started a two-week free trial activity, allowing developers and users to experience the powerful performance of the new model without any barriers.

The newly launched DeepSeek V4.1-Flash has officially been added to the DeepSeek API and features native multimodal support capabilities. When using the platform, users only need to adjust the model setting to the corresponding identifier to seamlessly switch and experience it. With the full integration and launch of the new version, the official has also synchronized the iteration plan for the old version. Early versions such as V4-Flash and V4-Flash-Vision-Exp have been officially retired, completing their historical mission during the transition period.
